description.purpose: Turns the fetcher's tool_result into a deliverable assistant turn: strips HTML tags (script/style dropped), collapses whitespace, truncates to a 3500-char excerpt under a 'Daily digest:' prefix, and recasts chat_id from context string to a numeric hop header.
description.use_when: Between a tool cell and a proxy sink — the proxy needs an assistant turn and edges may not touch the body (body transforms are code-cell work by spec).
description.not_in_scope: No summarization, no markdown rendering, no link extraction.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: one assistant text turn. hop.chat_id: numeric Telegram chat id, promoted to context by the out-edge for the proxy.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: the fetcher's tool_result (first one wins). context.chat_id: the digest chat id as a string (from the timer's emit_headers via promotion).
examples:
tool_result '

News

...' + context.chat_id '12345' -> assistant 'Daily digest:\nNews ...' (tag-free, whitespace-collapsed), hop { chat_id: 12345 }
